# Local Voice

> Private-first system-wide dictation for Apple Silicon Macs, with a native iPhone companion.

Local Voice is a desktop voice workspace and push-to-talk dictation app. Speech inference is routed through a local Parakeet process or a private loopback whisper-server; no hosted speech-to-text provider is configured. Model downloads and availability checks can use the network. Audio retention is off by default, while transcript history remains local and operator-controlled.

## Key facts

- **License**: MIT-licensed lineage; preserve third-party notices.
- **Desktop**: macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
- **Mobile**: native iPhone companion source with required on-device recognition.
- **Distribution**: local builds only until a Cipher-owned remote and signing identity are selected.
- **Configuration**: `~/.config/local-voice/config.json`.
- **Privacy boundary**: the built-in diagnostic verifies the selected local process or private-loopback route. The packaged Parakeet and Whisper paths also pass an OS-enforced external-egress test; independent packet capture remains a broader pre-distribution gate.

## Product surfaces

- Native control-room GUI with engine, model, route, separate microphone/Fn/text-insertion readiness, guided permission repair, and optional Launch at Login.
- Microphone-free `hotkey-diagnose` probe for the real Fn event tap.
- Microphone-free `pill-preview` harness for the bespoke Voice Aperture
  Listening and Locked state surface.
- Push-to-talk system-wide cursor insertion on macOS.
- Automatic Parakeet-to-persistent-Whisper routing with circuit-breaker fallbacks.
- App-specific modes, custom dictionary, local transcript history, and retention controls.
- Canonical v1 voice request/response receipts on default-private history records, with GUI JSON copy and a deterministic `contract-fixture` command.
- Native private file-transcription workspace for bounded audio/video queues, timestamped chunks, cancellation, and TXT, Markdown, JSON, SRT, and WebVTT exports.
- Repeatable short-corpus and long-form command-line performance benchmarks
  with machine-readable JSON receipts.
- Incremental live-preview audio with bounded overlap plus adaptive long-form
  cleanup so cumulative preview and synchronous Ollama regeneration do not
  dominate hotkey-release latency.
- Repeatable external-egress gate that preserves private loopback and emits a machine-readable receipt.
- Native iPhone companion project and Personal Team installation script.

## Performance evidence

See `BENCHMARK.md` for the measured macOS synthetic speech fixture, latency gates, word-error results, and limitations. Synthetic text-to-speech is a regression fixture, not a human-microphone or real-world accuracy claim.

## Current release boundary

Local Voice has not yet been published to a Cipher-owned remote or distributed through TestFlight or the App Store. A physical-iPhone signing team, real-device validation, human-speech testing, cursor-insertion testing, and independent packet capture remain explicit release gates.

The Local Voice surface is limited to `general.*` contract profiles and cannot
emit `poker.exploit`. The v1 receipt requires no retained audio, so explicitly
enabling local audio retention suppresses that receipt rather than weakening
the privacy assertion.

File transcription uses FFmpeg only for temporary local normalization. It
does not persist source paths or copied audio; job transcripts obey the same
local history setting and retention policy as dictation. The CLI entry point
is `local-voice transcribe-file <path> [txt|md|json|srt|vtt]`.
